name: robotbase-mcp
title: RobotBase MCP Server — on-chain verification & risk intelligence for Web3 agents
description: The semantic verification and risk-intelligence layer for Web3 agents, as one read-only MCP endpoint. Live: Bitcoin (fees, mempool state, tx/block/address verification, optional raw-tx relay), Ethereum (Reth execution + Lighthouse consensus state), Monero (node telemetry) and Zcash (node state + all six shielded value pools + recent blocks). Provisioning: Solana, Base and Tron, wired through light API aggregation rather than heavy local nodes. No public RPC endpoint is published, no tracking, no custody.

auth.optional: X-API-Key header or ?key= raises the rate limit to 600/min per IP

pricing.current: free during launch, no key required
planned: prepaid API key (USDT top-up), metered per call
pricing.experimental: X402 M2M settlement — lab track, not the billing system

tools.name: list_chains
tools.description: Every chain on the RobotBase roster with its state (live / provisioning / planned), live availability and block height. When to use: the user asks which chains are supported, which nodes are online, or where to start. Do not use: for one chain's live health use chain_status; for what a node can and cannot answer use robotbase_capabilities.

tools.name: chain_status
tools.description: Run-time state of one chain's node: block height, sync progress, connected peers, mempool depth, client version. When to use: whether a given chain's node is synced, healthy or lagging. Do not use: fees -> btc_get_fee_rates; a specific payment -> btc_get_transaction; ZEC pool distribution -> zec_get_pool_status.

tools.name: robotbase_capabilities
tools.description: What every node can and cannot answer, including pruning and retention limits, plus the fee models we support. When to use: before promising that a query is possible, or after a tool refused one as out of range. RobotBase publishes no RPC endpoint - every read path is this MCP surface.

tools.name: robotbase_services
tools.description: Live availability of every service behind the RobotBase gateway: the chain nodes, Web3 Agent Hub and MCP itself. When to use: an overall platform health check, or finding which service is down. Do not use: for a single chain's node state (chain_status).

tools.name: zec_get_pool_status
tools.description: Zcash chain state plus the distribution of all six value pools (transparent / sprout / sapling / orchard / ironwood / lockbox) with balances, share of supply and 1h/24h deltas, in one call. When to use: how much ZEC sits in each shielded pool and what share of supply is shielded. Do not use: we do not index Zcash transactions or wallets; node peers and disk usage -> chain_status.

tools.name: zec_get_recent_blocks
tools.description: Height, hash, block time and difficulty of the most recent N Zcash blocks (default 5, max 20). When to use: checking whether ZEC is producing blocks normally and at what interval. Do not use: for shielded-pool supply -> zec_get_pool_status.

tools.name: btc_get_fee_rates
tools.description: Bitcoin fee rates for 1/2/3/6/12/24-block confirmation targets plus the mempool floor, reported in sat/vB and BTC/kvB. When to use: pricing a Bitcoin transaction, or deciding when a sweep will confirm cheaply. Do not use: to measure backlog depth -> btc_get_mempool_state. There is no equivalent for Zcash: ZEC fees are protocol-fixed.

tools.name: btc_get_mempool_state
tools.description: Bitcoin mempool depth, capacity load, minimum fee, total fees and a busy/normal verdict. When to use: deciding whether now is a good moment to settle on-chain, or how large the backlog is. Do not use: to choose a fee -> btc_get_fee_rates.

tools.name: btc_get_transaction
tools.description: Look up one Bitcoin transaction by txid: confirmations, block, time, size/vsize, inputs and up to 12 outputs. When to use: the core settlement check - has this payment arrived, which block is it in, how deep is it. Do not use: a whole block -> btc_get_block; an address balance -> btc_get_address.

tools.name: btc_get_block
tools.description: Bitcoin block summary by height or block hash; omit both for the chain tip. Returns hash, height, time, tx count, size, weight, confirmations, previous block hash. When to use: an overview of a block, or confirming which block a payment landed in. Do not use: to fetch a single payment -> btc_get_transaction.

tools.name: btc_get_address
tools.description: Balance and activity of a Bitcoin address with no key involved: confirmed/unconfirmed balance, UTXO count and total, tx count, last 10 transactions. Supports P2PKH, P2SH, bech32 and bech32m. When to use: reconciling a merchant wallet. Do not use: we do not label or risk-score addresses; for a single payment -> btc_get_transaction.

tools.name: xmr_get_node_status
tools.description: Monero node state: height, sync flag, difficulty, txpool size, database size, monerod version and peer counts. When to use: whether the XMR node is synced and healthy, or how big its chain and txpool are. Boundary: RobotBase does not index Monero transactions, wallets or ring signatures - this tool is node telemetry only.

tools.name: broadcast_raw_transaction
tools.description: Relay an already-signed raw Bitcoin transaction to the network through our own full node (non-custodial: we never see a private key). When to use: an agent signed a transaction locally and wants a high-availability broadcast path. Disabled by default; the operator enables it with RB_ENABLE_BROADCAST=1.
